issues.message: this simulation requests NTFF far-field output but registers no point probe. run() and forward() score their ring-down settling witness from the recorded probe time series, so the result will carry settling_db=None and those DFT numbers will have no truncation guard (#885); add sim.add_probe(position, component) somewhere the field is live and retain its time series. Inspect forward's diagnostic on the concrete result after JIT/AD evaluation.
PEC boundary with NTFF far-field: PEC reflects all energy back into domain. Use boundary='cpml' or boundary='upml' for open structures (antennas, scatterers).

NTFF face z_lo is 10.00mm from geometry 'pec' — below λ/2 = 14.99mm at f_max=10.00GHz. Close to reactive near-field; far-field pattern accuracy may degrade. Move NTFF box ≥ λ/2 from radiating/scattering structures.
